name: tech.filmcraft/video-editing-assistant
title: FilmCraft — Video Editing Assistant MCP
description: Look up FilmCraft/Premiere shortcuts, GPU/codec compatibility, and YouTube/TikTok export presets.

tools.name: lookup_filmcraft_shortcut
tools.description: Look up FilmCraft and Adobe Premiere Pro equivalent keyboard shortcuts by action name or category (e.g., split, razor, export, text, ripple, playback). Returns formatted macOS/Windows/Linux bindings and migration guide links.

query.description: Action keyword or category to search (e.g. "split", "export", "text", "ripple", "playback"). Leave empty to list all core shortcuts.

os.description: Target operating system for modifier key formatting.

tools.name: check_workstation_compatibility
tools.description: Diagnose workstation hardware, OS, GPU, and video codec compatibility for running the open-source FilmCraft video editor, including Metal/NVENC acceleration and proxy workflow recommendations.

os.description: Operating system of the editing workstation.

gpu.description: GPU model or family (e.g., "Apple Silicon M2", "RTX 4070", "AMD RX 7800 XT", "Intel Integrated").

tools.name: get_export_preset
tools.description: Get recommended FilmCraft video export settings, bitrate targets, Rec.709 gamma-fix NCLC tags, and audio loudness specs for YouTube, TikTok/Reels/Shorts, or ProRes archival.

platform.description: Target delivery platform or archival codec preset.
